bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
{
echo PROFILE_BUTTON_CHAIN_READBACK
echo HOST_BRANCH="$(git branch --show-current)"
echo IMAGE="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
echo BOT_RUNNING="$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
echo USERBOT_ACTIVE="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)"
echo USERBOT_ENABLED="$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)"
echo USERBOT_IPC_CALLBACK_ACTION="$(grep -c profile_button_smoke "$root/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" || true)"
echo USERBOT_IPC_TEST_ACTION="$(grep -c profile_button_smoke "$root/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" || true)"
echo RUNTIME_BOT_ERRORS
docker logs --since 120m deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -E 'GAYBBS_ERROR|WIZARD_|GAYBBS_BOT_READY|GAYBBS_STARTUP_FAILED|ERROR|Error' | tail -25 | sed -E 's/[0-9]{9,}/[redacted]/g' || true
} | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
